snowpackStructure.comment: The snow depths are well below average for the time of year and are scarcely sufficient for snow sports in open terrain. Especially on shady slopes with smooth ground above approximately 2400 m, there is a cohesive layer of coarse-grained, weak old snow at the snow base. These weak layers are in places covered with wind drifted snow from the last few days. These wind slabs are prone to triggering.

tendency.comment: Individual avalanche prone locations for dry avalanches are to be found in particular in extremely steep terrain. Restraint should be exercised because avalanches can sweep people along and give rise to falls.
The danger of dry avalanches will increase. Persons can release avalanches in some places. Careful route selection is recommended.
